spans.s:
शेष a. [शिस्-अच्] Remaining,
rest, all the other; न्यषोधि
शेषोप्यनुयायिवर्गः

;
oft. at the end of comp. in this
sense; भक्षितशेष, आलेख्यशेष &c.
--षः
--षं
1 (a) Remainder, rest, residue;
ऋणशेषोग्निशेषश्च व्याधिशेषस्तथैव च ।
[]
पुनश्च वर्धते यस्मात्तस्माच्छेषं न कारयेत्

;
प्रतिकारविधानमायुषः सति शेषं हि फलाय कल्पते

. &c. (b) Surplus,
balance.
--2 Anything left out or
omitted to be said; (

is often
used by commentators in
supplying an ellipsis or words necessary
to complete the construction).
--3
Escape, salvation, respite.
--षः
1
Result, effect.
--2 End, termination,
conclusion.
--3 Death, destruction.
--4 N. of a celebrated serpent, said
to have one thousand heads, and
represented as forming the couch of
Viṣṇu or as supporting the entire
world on his head; किं शेषस्य
भरव्यथा न वपुषि क्ष्मां न क्षिपत्येष यत्

.
--5 N. of
Balarāma (supposed to be an incarnation
of Śeṣa).
--6 An elephant.
--षा
The remains of flowers or other
offerings made to an idol and
distributed among the worshippers as a
holy relique; तथोति शेषामिव
भर्तुराज्ञामादाय मूर्ध्ना मदनः प्रतस्थे

,
Ś. 3.
--षं The remnants of food,
remains of an offering. (शेषे is used
adverbially in the sense of {1} at
last, finally.
--2 in other cases; as
in शेषे षष्ठी).
--Comp.
--अन्नं
leavings of food.
--अवस्था old age.
--कालः the time of death.
--जातिः
f. assimilation of residues.
--भागः
the remainder.
--भोजनं the eating
of leavings.
--रात्रिः the last watch
of the night.
--शयनः, --शायिन् m.
epithets of Viṣṇu.
